summary: Lost hiker in Section 16 (Palmer Trail) off Gold Camp Road; Colorado Springs Fire Department initially dispatched to the 400 block of Gold Camp Road on a high-angle rescue report, then treated it as a lost-hiker search, going up the trail on motorcycles; hiker found.
location: Section 16 (Palmer Trail), Gold Camp Road, Colorado Springs
notes: Resolves the parked 2016-05-23 Section 16 lead (runs 996/1013): headline 'Springs firefighters find lost hiker' confirms the find; body text describes the search under way and the hiker's condition is not stated.
